encoder.quantization: Dynamic per-channel INT8 MatMul/Gemm weights; convolution remains float32
encoder.all_benchmarks_use: This exact quantized ONNX artifact, not the source PyTorch encoder

protocol.calibration: Every fifth sorted normal training image; excluded from reference sampling
protocol.threshold: 95th percentile of held-out-normal image scores, method=higher
protocol.image_score: Mean of largest 1% of patch cosine distances
protocol.localization: Bilinear 16x16 to 56x56 anomaly map, Gaussian sigma=1; masks nearest-resized
protocol.selection: Fixed settings; no defective training images or test-tuned thresholds
protocol.corruptions: Blur radius 2, brightness x0.65, JPEG quality 25; applied after resizing, references unchanged
